title: Pedestrian Deaths Rose 77% While Traffic Deaths Fell
hook: Pedestrian deaths rose 77% while roads got safer overall.
closing: Safer roads overall can still leave people walking at greater risk.
question: Do your streets feel walkable?

segments.say: US traffic deaths fell to 40,990, yet people walking remained the outlier.
Pedestrian deaths rose 77%, breaking away from the broader safety trend.
Pedestrians were about 18% of traffic deaths, making this exception a major safety problem.
